standplan.title: Stall plan
standplan.prototype: Prototype · data only in this browser
standplan.subtitle: Drag requests from the mailbox onto rows, review proposals and confirm. The vendor gets the confirmation by mail.
standplan.noEvents: No upcoming events with rows. Add zones and rows to the location first.
standplan.keysHint: Drag: drag a request from the list onto a row, move stalls on the plan. Keyboard: click a stall, then ← → moves 50 cm (1 m with Shift), ↑ ↓ changes row, Delete takes it off the plan, Esc clears the selection. Without a mouse: “Place in …” in the details.
standplan.emptyOpen: No open requests for this event.

map.label: Site plan {venue}
map.cars: {count, plural, one {# car space} other {# car spaces}}

layout.hint: Drag rows to move them, click a row to rotate it.

toast.noRoom: No room for this in row {row}
toast.confirmed: {count, plural, one {# confirmation} other {# confirmations}} sent (Mailbox → Sent)
toast.versionLoadedSkipped: “{name}” loaded; {skipped, plural, one {# stall no longer fits} other {# stalls no longer fit}} (confirmed or taken meanwhile)
toast.autoplatzWhy: Auto-place: {placed} proposed, {left} without space (reasons are shown on the requests)

versions.title: Versions
versions.name: Version name
versions.hint: Saves only the proposals; no mail is sent. Confirmed stalls stay unchanged when loading.

why.title: Doesn't fit anywhere right now
why.gapRule: a gap exists, but it would leave pieces under 2 m (gap rule)
why.hintCar: Tip: place without a car (check with the vendor) or free a car space in a car row.
why.hintGapRule: Tip: turn off “No leftover gaps under 2 m” above or move neighbouring stalls.
why.hintPower: Tip: check power with the vendor; only rows with a power connection qualify.
why.hintSpace: Tip: move neighbouring stalls together or agree a shorter stall with the vendor.
